sentences.text: The petition was filed before the LAC and referred to by the Collector for determination of the court.

2. The brief factual matrix leading to the present petition is that the Government vide notification bearing No. F.11(19)/2001/L&B/LA/20112 dt. 21.03.2003 issued by the Lt. Governor of Delhi under Section 4 of the Act, Government intended to acquire about 2480 Bigha 01 Biswas of land with its specification mentioned in the notification for public purpose namely 'Rohini Residential Scheme'
under the "Planned Development of Delhi".
3. The Government vide consequent Declaration/notification No. F.11 (19)/2001/L&B/LA/28176 dated 19.03.2004 issued pursuant thereto under Section 6 of the Act, acquired 2480 Bigha 01 Biswas land (as detailed in the statement under Section 19 of the Act), situated in the revenue estate of village Mubarakpur Dabas, Delhi.
The LAC (N/W)

after completing all the requisite formalities as provided under the Act, announced the Award bearing no. 16 of 200506 dated 14.09.2005 u/s 11 of the Act in respect of 2480 bighas 01 biswas out of the aforesaid said land and awarded a compensation at the uniform rate of Rs.15,70,000/ per acre (or Rs. 3,27,083.33/ per bigha) for the entire said land in addition to other statutory benefits and interests.
LAC no. 407/ 2016 (Award No. 16/200506/DC(NW)) Jagdev & Ors. Vs. Union of India Page no. 3 of 12 4.

5.

It is stated that the Award passed by the ld. LAC is not acceptable to the petitioners and,
therefore, this reference has been filed with a view to reassess the market value of the land which Jagdev Ors. (1605-06) vs Union Of India (Mubarakpur Dabas) on 9 December, 2023 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/103328798/

6. Following are the grounds under which the reference petition has been filed :

i) The LAC has not considered that the said land is very fertile and fit for all commercial, residential, industrial, etc purposes and the said land is levelled more than 2 feet height from the nearby land.
The said land bears no defects but the LAC has assessed the market value at very low rate.
ii) The revenue estate of Village Mubarakpur Dabas is situated near the National Highway No. 10, Delhi Rohtak Road and the land in question is near Main Karala Mundka Road.

The said estate is surrounded by many prestigious colonies/village/
Industries area, etc and the value of each every commodity has been raised day by day, the value of which has also been increased day by day.
LAC no. 407/ 2016 (Award No. 16/200506/DC(NW)) Jagdev & Ors. Vs.
Union of India Page no. 4 of 12

iii) The said Land has got potential value as many purposes and the same has been surrounded by Villages Mundka, Ghevra, Kanjhawala, Nangloi, Karala, Kirari, Nithari, etc and it the market value is not less than Rs. 5,000/ per sq. yards.
iv) The land of the petitioners is adjacent to welldeveloped areas, colonies and hence has a great market value.

The land enjoys all type of modern facilities/ amenities like developed telephone,
electricity, water connection, public school, Govt. School and most frequently severed by DTC,
Railway Station and other transportation.

v) The LAC has not legally assessed the market value of the land rather he has wholly and solely relied on the policy announcement and which come into effect from the financial year 20012002 in which the Government fixed the indicative prices of agricultural land at the rate of Rs. 15.70 lacs per acre for the acquisition of the Agricultural land.
The LAC has further not made any efforts to find out the market value of the land in the village.

vi) The land of the petitioners is situated on the Main road and very close to PVC market tikri,
Indian bottling Plant Ghevra, Chara Mandi Tikri, Netaje Subhash Tourism Centre, Proposed Spots Academy at Ghevra, Metro Workshop Mundka and thousands of Industries working at the time of the notification in the surrounding area.
The prestigious seats of learning Sir Chhotu Ram Polytechnic Kanjhawala, Sir Chhotu Ram High School, Haryana Shakti High School are very close to the land of petitioner.

Many developed colonies exists in the surrounding area i.e. Prem Nagar,
Rama LAC no. 407/ 2016 (Award No. 16/200506/DC(NW)) Jagdev & Ors.
Vs. Union of India Page no. 5 of 12 vihar, Agar, Pratap Vihar, Bhagya Vihar
. All these factors indicate the market value of the land is not less than Rs. 5,000/ per sq. yards.

sentences.text: There is no evidence on record to gather that the land of the petitioners herein was in any way inferior to the land involved in Savitri Devi (supra).
The petitioners are, accordingly entitled to the same compensation for their land as was awarded in Savitri Devi (supra).
This court adjudicate the market value of land of the petitioners as Rs.19,45,800/ per acre thereby giving an enhancement of Rs.3,75,800/ per acre.
21. The petitioners have not led any evidence with respect to alleged damages of the growing crops and structures or other claims.
Therefore, the petitioners shall not be entitled to any damages on the aforesaid counts.
This issue is decided accordingly in favour of the petitioners.
ISSUE NO. 2/ RELIEF 22.

25//11 min (108) has not been taken which has been admitted by the petitioner.

Therefore,
petitioner is not entitled for enhancement of compensation qua this land.

23. In view of the findings on Issue No.1, the petitioners are granted the following reliefs: LAC no.
407/ 2016 (Award No. 16/200506/DC(NW)) Jagdev & Ors. Vs.
Union of India Page no. 11 of 12 (1)

Fair Market value of land of petitioners as mentioned in the revised statement u/s 19 of the Act @
Rs.19,45,800/- per acre.
An enhancement of Rs.3,75,800/- per acre is accordingly accorded.

(2)
Additional amount @ 12% ( in terms of Section 23 (1A) of the Act).
(3) Solatium @ 30% on the enhanced compensation (in terms of S.23 (2) of the Act).

(4) Interest @ 9% per annum for the first year and 15% per annum for the subsequent year till the payment of enhanced compensation by LAC is made (in terms of Section 28 of the Act).
24.
Reference petition is accordingly, answered with parties to bear their own respective costs.
Decree sheet be drawn accordingly.
File be consigned to record room after due compliance.
